name: Cinescape
description: A cinematic playground for cinephiles. Discover films, shows, anime, cartoons & talents. Curate watchlists, track watches, rate titles, and showcase your cinematic taste.

paragraphs: Cinescape is a cinematic playground for cinephiles—a space to discover, track, and celebrate everything on screen. Explore films, TV shows, anime, cartoons, and the talents behind them; uncover hidden gems and your next obsession; curate personal watchlists, log viewing history, rate titles, and express your cinematic taste through customizable profiles. Built with React 18 and TypeScript, Cinescape combines TMDB-powered discovery with a polished, responsive experience made for cinema culture.
features: 🎞️ Films, Shows & More: Discover films, TV shows, anime, and cartoons in one cinematic space.
🎬 Cinematic Discovery: Find trending titles, cult classics, hidden gems, and your next obsession with TMDB-powered data.
⭐ Curated Rankings: Explore top-rated films, trending picks, and standout shows.
🎭 Talent Discovery: Explore actors, directors, and other creative talents and their work.
❤️ Favorites & Watchlists: Save favorite titles and talents and organize your personal watchlists.
